title: Troitsky’s Genius!
reviewNotes: Late 34 physical-board frames re-reviewed, with native 169-second ...Kf5 and 172-second Qxh8 diagrams cross-checked. The complete eight-piece root is proved by Qxh8 into an exact seven-piece Black loss. Independent Ke6/h6/Rh4/h7/Rxh7/Qxh7 shows a pawn diversion with both e-pawns preserved. Earlier larger Kb7/Nf4/shepherding choices remain outside proof.
